observation_summary: A NullPointerException occurs in SubLine.intersection() when lines do not intersect, because the code attempts to project a null intersection point into sub-space.
reasoning_summary: The intersection() method calls line.intersection(subLine.line), which returns null for non-intersecting lines. The subsequent code immediately passes this null result to line.toSubSpace(), which then triggers an NPE. The fix requires a guard to check if the intersection point is null before attempting to process it further.
evidence_used: Bug report description: 'When calling SubLine.intersection() with two lines that not intersect, then a NullPointerException is thrown'

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the logic flow is involved, the root cause is the lack of a guard against a null return value from the intersection calculation, which is a classic Checking defect.
